stem: One difference between the speaker in the poem and the narrator of the selection is that the speaker —

options.label: F
options.text: receives more than he expected, while the narrator’s performance did not meet her expectations

options.label: G
options.text: is pleased with the process of growing plants, while the narrator was annoyed with the results of her work

options.label: H
options.text: has to be patient in order to achieve his goal, while the narrator had to practice in order to achieve her goal

options.label: J
options.text: worries about what others say, while the narrator did not listen to the opinions of others
